C0852.title: Asiainfo Security Explains the Rise of Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS)
C0852.summary: In September 2022, Asiainfo Security highlighted that the rise of Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) has transformed ransomware attacks from small-scale solo operations into modular, industrialized, and specialized large-scale campaigns, broadening attack coverage and significantly increasing damage. The RaaS model further enhances attack stealth, making ransomware operations increasingly professional

references.title: Undeterred by Ransomware Storm: A Detailed Look at Asiainfo Security's 'Ark' Plan
